# Lane 2.47: Season settings screen (handover, 2026-11-22)

Branch `lane/2.47-season-settings`, picked up after five days; not pushed (the lead pushes).

## What the lane holds

- Admin → Season settings (`apps/web/src/features/season-settings`, `apps/web/src/app/[league]/admin/season`): the "Who can see this season" panel of step 2.182, kept; then one form per part: name and dates; game rules with the High school and Rec league presets ("Use …" fills the boxes and saves nothing); how games are recorded and the statistics kept; standings (rank by, points per result, tiebreaker order, ties, forfeits, columns); rosters (unique jerseys). Roster limits, lock date and coin flip are shown "Not in use yet"; the team-foul reset is not a choice and follows the game's periods; "last five" is not offered. The word "program" never shows.
- After a result, a save that moves the standings asks first, naming the teams it moves (S-1, step 2.25); "Yes" saves it.
- The public standings draw the columns the season chose, in its order (`apps/web/src/features/stats-pages/build-standings.ts`); percentages read .500 and 1.000.
- Rules saved on the stand-in and through the database ports; message texts in `packages/site/src/messages/en/admin-settings.ts`.
- Merge of `build/stage-1` (321 commits), six conflicts: read-standings (both `columns` and 2.198's `pointsPer` kept); build-standings (the build branch's one set of columns for every table with its phone layout `narrow`, now drawn from the season's chosen columns); its test (both new blocks kept); saved-notice (screens of both sides); database-admin-settings (shared transaction, the build's event handlers for `deps`, the lane's `seasons` ports); stand-in-world-standings (both imports).

## Decisions (pending files in `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/`)

- S-79, Decided for you: the season's chosen columns in its order; ties added just after the last column a phone shows once a game is tied; none chosen draws the standard set (no ties, points, last five). P7 section 1 now says so. The ID S-79 was taken by this lane: check no other lane used it.
- T-290, Agreed (delegated): each part saves only its own fields over the rules read fresh at save, sent with the version the page showed (a save after another's is refused, typing kept); PTS only in a table ranked by points. Record 088 not written (T-290 is enough).
